nums ← [5, 2, 4, 1]
n ← LEN(nums)
FOR i ← 0 TO n - 2
    swapped ← False
    FOR j ← 0 TO n - 1 - i - 1
        IF nums[j] > nums[j + 1] THEN
            # swap the two values using temp
            temp ← nums[j]
            nums[j] ← nums[j + 1]
            nums[j + 1] ← temp
            swapped ← True
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF NOT swapped THEN
        break  [!]
    ENDIF
ENDFOR
OUTPUT nums
